document.abstract: In the 21st century, cinema is no longer confined to a theatrical setting. With consumers seeking content via multiple distribution outlets, creators are working hard to maintain artistic intent in an ever-evolving landscape. However, should that be the highest priority? The Future of Cinema Conference program explored this and other thought-provoking questions.
